basic_info.description: Experience refined coastal living in this masterfully reimagined Outer Parkside residence. Behind a sleek modern door, a luminous open floor plan unfolds, featuring stunning wood floors, multiple skylights, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The designer kitchen features a waterfall island, custom cabinetry, and stainless appliances. Spa-inspired baths invite relaxation with deep soaking tubs or rain showers or both! Entertain with ease on the rear vista deck, or backyard outdoor dining area or conversation area with the fire pit. Enjoy true indoor-outdoor living with a vista point deck, fire pit patio, and a spacious backyard. Redesigned from the studs with new electrical, new plumbing, interior laundry wth new washer and dryer, permits in place, and luxury finishes throughout. Ideally located near Ocean Beach, Lake Merced trails, top schools, cafes along Noriega & Taraval and transit. Coastal luxury, city convenience, endless possibilities. A true sanctuary where luxury meets coastal charm.
